notes.title: Estate Escape DLC fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A few days ago, we released our latest DLC for Tales of Escape, "Estate Escape". Some of you have been vocal about the things you did not like about this DLC. We hear you, and have been hard at work fixing the existing puzzles of the map as well as adding some new ones! Bellow there's a list of changes:

[list]
[*] Domino puzzle has been reworked and a hint has been added
[*] Added a cryptic puzzle in the office
[*] Moved letter to make puzzles more linear
[*] Added an observation puzzle in the dining room
[*] Fixed an issue with hints getting stuck before the dominoes puzzle
[*] Fixed an issue with hints getting stuck if the player solves the curtain puzzle before solving the others in the room
[*] Added more props all over the level
[*] Moved metal bar to a more reasonable place
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback, as always we are hear to learn and we appreciate your support in this. We hope that this update addresses some of your concerns, please let us know what you think.

Thank you,
    OnSkull Games

notes.title: The update is (finally) here!

A new update for [b]Tales of Escape[/b] has just been released! Apologies for the delay, we have been reading [b][i]your feedback on "Sleepy Hollow"[/i][/b] and decided on delaying the update in order to improve that DLC. Here is a list of some of the changes in this update:

notes.title: Tales of Escape v2.4 - Sleepy Hollows
notes.content:
Hello Players,

We are excited to release the next room in the series: 
[h1]Sleepy Hollow! [/h1]

It is the night of Halloween and you find yourselves locked in a spooky graveyard after midnight. Can you figure out what's going on and escape before it’s too late?

[h1] Changes [/h1]
Update 2.4 also brings a lot of Quality of Life improvements to Tales of Escape, here's a list of them:
[list]
[*] Added a torso to the player avatar so that it can be seen easier from further away.
[*] Added a "Reset items" button in the main menu, this feature is in beta, but should solve all problems with lost items during play.
[*] Fixed a few puzzles in Illusion that would sometimes bug and stop progression
[*] Fixed floors in "The Mine" to have more consistent colliders.
[*] Reworked hints so that they don't immediately give you the answer to a puzzle.
[/list]

That's it for now, thank you for playing and as always, have fun!
OnSkull Games

notes.title: ToE Illusion is here!
notes.content:
Hello players,

As promised, [h1]Tales of Escape - Illusion[/h1] is finally here! This new adventure is a lot longer than the other ones, featuring up to 5 times the puzzles others have! Are you ready to tackle it down?

[h1]Technical Details:[/h1]
We decided to release Illusion in 2 separate DLCs, one for players who want to play it in Virtual Reality OR Desktop and one for players who want to play it only on regular desktop computers (for a discounted price). This way we hope to make it easier for desktop users to get into Tales of Escape, while still making our games for VR (we are passionate about VR and don't want to stop making games for it).

[h1]Will I be able to play the game without VR, if I buy the VR version?[/h1]
Absolutely, the VR version includes Desktop play!

Thank you to all our beta testers, stay tuned for a last round of emails!

Thank you,
    OnSkull Games

notes.title: Going Free2Play and upcoming content
notes.content:
Hello players,

As you might be able to see, Tales of Escape is undergoing huge changes, here's what you need to know:

[h1] Going Free to Play [/h1]
Tales of Escape is now free to play! There is a new adventure out called "The 
Mine" and it is available to everyone for free! So gather your friends and give it a try! Along with "The Mine", comes the new Lobby of Tales of Escape, which will work as a hub for all the other adventures.

[h1] What happened to Cold As Ice[/h1]
Cold as Ice (the previous adventure that was sold with Tales of Escape) is now a DLC. Everyone who had bought Tales of Escape, will receive a free copy of it and will be able to select and play it in the game's Lobby.

[h1] What happens now? [/h1]
There is more to come! Next up is "Illusion" a room that you kindly helped beta test just a few weeks back, that will be coming out as a DLC very soon! Furthermore, there are 2 more rooms in the works, [i] I wonder what those could be about ;) [/i]

[h1] Enjoy! [/h1]
As always, we are here to improve, please don't hesitate to give us your feedback, thoughts and ideas on everything. Thanks for playing and see you soon!

notes.title: ToE v1.2 - New Avatars, improved interaction system, fixed voice chat!
notes.content:
Hello players,

In preparation of our new DLC going into Beta testing, we have made some changes to "Tales of Escape: Cold As Ice" that we are rolling out today. Here is a list of the changes:

[list]
[*] New Avatars. As those of you who follow us on Facebook might have seen, we  have prepared a humanoid head avatar to replace the PC monitors and VR headsets. Also, VR players now have hands instead of controllers in-game!
[*] In an ongoing effort to simplify the controls of the game, we have removed the arrow key/d-pad unlocker and our new code panels have buttons that can be pressed! The small screen you have, now functions as a clock.
[*] Users reported an issue with our in-game voice chat not working on some computers, this should now be fixed.
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]

That's it for now, thanks for playing and we will see you soon with more news on the new DLC!

notes.title: Oculus Rift Full Support + Visuals Upgrade!
notes.content:
Oculus Rift headsets are now Officially Supported! We also revamped the graphic style of the game, rebuilding a lot of things from scratch. In gameplay terms, nothing changed. You can still play with VR (Vive or Rift), or without it, you can still play with up to 5 other friends (VR or not). So, play away!

[h1]VR Specific:[/h1]
Oculus Rift support
180 degree support
Height adjustment
D-Pad movement


[h1]Visuals:[/h1]
Higher quality models
SMAA Anti-aliasing will provide a smoother, faster effect
Physically based rendering materials
All Post-Processing effects have been redesigned

We really hope that you will enjoy this experience!

Got feedback? Any requests? Let us know and we'll be on it! :)

notes.title: Update and things to come
notes.content:
Greetings players!

[b][u]A new update is out![/u][/b] We hope to fix some of the issues and problems you were having :).

It's been a few days since our launch and you guys and girls have given us lots of feedback. Some of it positive, some of it, less so, but important nevertheless!

[b]What you told us:[/b]
[list]
[*]The game looks and feels nice but...
[*]It's too short, and...
[*]It feels like there is no backstory!
[/list]

[b]What are we doing about it?[/b]
[list]
[*]Well, for a start we are adding more content!
[*]We are adding the rest of the story which we missed before!
[/list]

[b]A longer explanation of changes:[/b]
[i] - Finding a balance between too easy and too hard is, well, not easy, and we experimented with lots of different options. In the end we felt like we wanted to be more "generous" - it's better to think that a game was too easy than to think it's impossible to beat right? Well... it appears that we underestimated our audience. While we mainly tested our game with "escape-room goers", we apparently missed the fact that PC players are at least as much, if not more, familiar with puzzles! As a response we added a few more puzzles to the mix - and we also tried to make those puzzles a bit more inter-connecting, as most of our previous riddles were only based in one room. We are also preparing some changes in the decoration of the rooms, we feel that some parts of the game feel a bit "empty".

 - The story on the other hand is another topic. While we planned and wrote the plot from an early time, we made the (obviously not ideal) decision to put storyline in a secondary role since we needed to do so much else. This really showed and while we had a plan we, well, didn't put it in the game! As soon as the first reviews came in this became obvious and we set out to add all those missing bits.[/i]

[b]That's it for now[/b], thank you for being here and please continue to share your thoughts and ideas, this game is meant to shine in the long run, when we are more experienced with what people like to see and there is a lot more content for you to enjoy.

Well... it appears that we underestimated our audience. While we mainly tested our game with "escape-room goers", we apparently missed the fact that PC players are at least as much, if not more, familiar with puzzles! As a response we added a few more puzzles to the mix - and we also tried to make those puzzles a bit more inter-connecting, as most of our previous riddles were only based in one room. We are also preparing some changes in the decoration of the rooms, we feel that some parts of the game feel a bit "empty".

 - The story on the other hand is another topic. While we planned and wrote the plot from an early time, we made the (obviously not ideal) decision to put storyline in a secondary role since we needed to do so much else. This really showed and while we had a plan we, well, didn't put it in the game! As soon as the first reviews came in this became obvious and we set out to add all those missing bits.[/i]

[b]That's it for now[/b], thank you for being here and please continue to share your thoughts and ideas, this game is meant to shine in the long run, when we are more experienced with what people like to see and there is a lot more content for you to enjoy.

notes.title: Tales of Escape is alive! Ready to get COLD?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28140984/31c5d7041f0895413006686ba14d892b2fb3ad4b.png[/img]

Hello and welcome to [b]Tales of Escape[/b],

[b]Tales of Escape: Cold As Ice[/b] is an escape room adventure-puzzle game you can play with your friends, even if only some of you have a Vive [i](or none!)[/i].

We begin our journey into the unknown with [b]"Cold As Ice"[/b] the first entry of Tales of Escape that comes with the base game. You find yourselves locked in the butcher shop that's down the road from your place, you remember a friendly couple that owned this place welcoming you whenever you visited but not this time, this time it's somehow different, scarier. Just what happened here in the past and what will happen to you if you don't escape?

[i]Rally up to 5 of your friends and find out![/i]

More rooms are planned as DLC in the future, if you played the game, please give us your thoughs and ideas, who knows, they just might become a reality!

Thank you everyone and have a good time escaping!
